content: Given the observation of the eigenvalues distribution of word vectors, we could see that word vectors that belong to the same context, i.e., same class, are suitable for subspace representation. Our analysis showed that half of the word vector space dimensions suffice to represent most of the variability of the data in each class of the Reuters-8 database.
